note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it. Guides are this entry's own words; each cites the launch-week guides and trophy databases it draws on. Five trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch and are marked unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops automatically once the last one lands. Expect around 200 hours in total, most of it on the 100% completion checklist behind A Long Road, so treat the platinum as the end of the roadmap, not a trophy to chase on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first mission of the story and the trophy unlocks automatically when it ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop a little late, after the first mission or two of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not land on the final cutscene.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it can pop a little late, once you are a mission or two into Chapter 3.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Chapter trophies can pop a little late, after the first mission or two of the next chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Chapter trophies can pop a little late, once you are a mission or two into the final chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save from before the ending is the only way back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission, which is what makes the partner trophies possible.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Like every story trophy it unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story trophies unlock automatically, so just play the mission through.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story and holds 35 tasks: the main story, 100 optional missions, all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 34 smash 'n' grabs, 50 stick-ups, all 8 bank vaults, $100,000 fenced narcotics, $100,000 fenced jewelry, $250,000 laundered marked bills, $200,000 fenced vehicles, 5 Kenton sets, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 magazines, books and comics, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 100 cocaine flamingos destroyed, 2 unique playlists, 70 styles discovered, 30 unique races won, 10 race gold medals, 42 shooting range gold medals, 4 video games played, 5 pool opponents beaten, 2 mini golf locations, 90 basketball hoops, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 15 of Bret's target decks, 200 of 277 base model vehicles scanned, 50 standard-issue weapons and 100 animals studied. Work you did during the story already counts, so scan vehicles and study animals as you go.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the world, and 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, as PowerPyx lists them. One try of each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two shooting ranges. Gold on every challenge is the hard part of this one, so practice the timed challenges and come back with better weapons as you unlock them.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough, and 100% completion also wants 42 drone time trials, so keep racing after the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and 100% completion needs 30 unique races won, so this comes on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1, so accept the challenge when it arrives and out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game: play one in-game video game through to the end. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth on arcade machines, and any of the four counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts with a phone call in Chapter 3, and it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's treasure-diving strand covers 7 shipwrecks; he goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand runs at the mud club in Kelly County and opens in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some side questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3: it is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass icon, and the strand counts toward this trophy, so save first, then race.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.warning: Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon): do it the moment it appears.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a wish list of 16 sports cars and opens in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is about shutting down labs in Vice City; it is Jason-only and starts in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots, shown as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. MISSABLE: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia walks out to the balcony to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task; it is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and PowerPyx flags it as the one trophy that may be missable. Do it when it appears and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.warning: MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter. Do it when it appears and keep a Chapter 1 save.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only, from Chapter 2, and runs through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it, so clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% completion needs anyway, should cover it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. Cards are found across Leonida, and 100% completion needs 15 sets, so this comes early in the hunt.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with the WAiNK phone app; 100% completion needs the same 100 spots, so the two finish together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges; 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, and many complete on their own while you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need Jason and Lucia together, which is possible once switching opens after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Bank vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away, so this pops naturally while robbing vaults with your partner, but only once you have left the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you: if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive; you do not have to drive them. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim, L3 and R3 while aiming; pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. PowerPyx notes gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to, and Adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door, because kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. 100% completion needs all 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier in the game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the entire map, all 52 areas. A plane is the fastest way to cover the map, so fly the coast and the interior in wide passes until nothing is left in fog.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% completion checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description is the only hint, and it may pop while you play normally. This guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description is the only hint, and it may pop while you play normally. This guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2: bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables, the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb, then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: max out Strength on both Jason and Lucia. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind; just keep playing and check the counter under Progress.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed unlock method at launch; PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store. This guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No confirmed unlock method at launch; PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline. This guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No confirmed method at launch: the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. Try a melee strike from a moving bike and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts; the dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission. The total is cumulative, and 100% completion needs the same $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop; guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
